questions.question: ServiceNow provides a suite of CMDB management tools designed to effectively ingest, manage, and maintain CIs and relationships. Drag and drop the design architecture to its management tool.
questions.explanation: Agent Client Collector = agent-based, running patterns; Discovery = agentless, running patterns; Import Sets = organization-built using transform maps; Service Graph Connectors = pre-built Store integrations that minimize customization. 'Third-party integrations from other vendors' is the distractor. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-sgc-intro.html

items.text: Pre-built store integration solutions that require minimal customization

targets.label: Agent Client Collector
Import Sets
Service Graph Connector
ServiceNow Discovery

questions.question: CMDB class owners are receiving tasks under the ‘My Work’ tab in the CMDB Workspace.Which CMDB management tool is generating these tasks?
questions.explanation: The tasks in CMDB Workspace > My Work are generated by published CMDB Data Manager policies (attestation, certification, life-cycle) and assigned per Managed By Group. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/yokohama/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-workspace-govern-view.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator is implementing a Vulnerability Response or Security Incident Response and needs to ensure customers have enough context to estimate risk and set task priorities.Which Get Well Playbook from the CSDM Data Foundation Dashboard helps with this?

choices.text: Named Product Models without Product Owners
Percentage of Custom Status Values for CI Life Cycle Stages
Application Services with Business Application Relationships

questions.explanation: Security tools need to know which business application (and its data) a vulnerable service instance supports, which needs the Application Service -> Business Application relationship (Crawl tab metric). Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/csdm-datafdn-dash-crawl-tab.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator wants only the CIs of Principal Classes to appear in CI reference fields, for example the CI reference fields accessible from an Incident Form.Where does the CMDB Administrator designate Principal Classes?
questions.explanation: Select the Principal Class check box in CI Class Manager > Class Info > Basic Info. CI reference fields on the task types in the principal-class filter property (incident, problem, change and their tasks) then show only CIs from principal classes. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/update-principal-class-filter.html

questions.question: When integrating data into the CMDB using import sets and transform maps, which type of script is added to ensure the data is processed through the IRE?
questions.explanation: Coalescing only matches within the transform map and bypasses the IRE. ServiceNow's documented method is to call the CMDBTransformUtil API from an onBefore transform script so each row is identified by the IRE before insert. There is no system property that turns the IRE on for transform maps. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/identification-import-sets.html

questions.question: What keeps the data volume in the CMDB manageable?
questions.explanation: CMDB Data Manager Archive policies (built on platform System Archive) manage table growth by moving stale CIs out of the active tables. Custom scheduled jobs or business rules are not the recommended approach. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-data-management.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator wants to run the Services Have Owners Identified playbook to remediate the issues shown in the CMDB Data Foundations Dashboard.Which remediation plays would be used? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: The Services Have Owners Identified playbook uses Analyze Data (find services with missing owners) and Fix Data (populate the owner fields); Govern Data is the preventive play. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-data-foundations-dashboard.html

questions.question: The following Reconciliation Rules were configured for the Windows Server [cmdb_ci_win_server] class (all attributes): ServiceNow priority 100, Altiris priority 200, SCCM priority 300. Which are true? (Choose two.)

choices.text: Data collected with a discovery source of SCCM can update any record in the Windows Server [cmdb_ci_win_server] table because it has the highest priority number.
Data collected with a discovery source of ServiceNow can insert new records into the Windows Server [cmdb_ci_win_server] table, but cannot update records created by Altiris or SCCM.
Data collected with a discovery source of Altiris can update records inserted by SCCM into the Windows Server [cmdb_ci_win_server] table.
Data collected with a discovery source of SCCM can be inserted as new records in the Windows Server [cmdb_ci_win_server] table.

questions.explanation: Smaller numbers mean higher priority, so SCCM (300) is the LOWEST priority (A is false) and ServiceNow (100) can update records from Altiris and SCCM (B is false). Altiris (200) outranks SCCM, so it can update SCCM-created records (C). Reconciliation only applies to updates - inserts aren't reconciled, so SCCM can still insert new CIs (D). (Priority table reconstructed: the original image was missing from the source.) Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/create-reconciliation-rule.html

questions.question: A CMDB Manager wants to improve data quality using the CMDB Health Dashboard.What needs to happen to generate CMDB health scores?

choices.text: Nothing, CMDB health scores are calculated by default
The plugin, CMDB health calculation, needs to be installed
The scheduled jobs for the CMDB Health Dashboard must be activated

questions.explanation: The CMDB Health Dashboard jobs are disabled by default, and no health data is collected until you activate those scheduled jobs. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/c_CMDBHealthSetupandConfig.html

questions.question: A Configuration Management Governance team is transitioning from utilizing legacy CMDB status fields to CSDM life cycle status fields.Which table can be modified?
questions.explanation: Only the Life Cycle Mapping [life_cycle_mapping] rules (legacy status -> CSDM stage/status pair) are meant to be updated. Life Cycle Stage, Stage Status and Control hold the ServiceNow-owned standard values and valid combinations. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/csdm-life-cycle-standard-values.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator has installed a Service Graph Connector and customized a script transform.What will happen on subsequent upgrades if the default definition of the script transform is updated?

choices.text: A skipped change is created and no change is made the script transform definition.
The Service Graph Connector upgrade refuses to start.
The upgrade stops and reports an error.

questions.explanation: Changing an SGC's data source query, script or mapping makes it a customer customization. On upgrade the platform keeps your version, logs a Skipped Update/skipped change to review, and you merge manually - nothing goes inactive and the upgrade doesn't stop. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/service-graph-connectors/upgrade-sccm-newer-version.html

questions.question: The CMDB Configuration Manager is using the CI Class Manager to manage the group ownership of CI classes and needs to leverage the ownership value specified in the CI Class Manager.When configuring a CMDB Data Manager policy, which group reference field should be set?
questions.explanation: CI Class Manager sets the Managed By Group for a whole class, and Data Manager creates/approves tasks per Managed By Group value - so Managed By Group is the field that aligns policy tasks with class ownership. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/csdm-data-synchronize-enable.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator is comparing the Unified Map to the Service Mapping map.What are additional capabilities of the Unified Map? (Choose two.)

choices.text: Number of levels displayed on a map can be modified
Visibility to an application and the host it is installed on
Map nodes can be filtered based on user preferences
Map can be zoomed in and out

questions.explanation: Unified Map lets you change the number of relationship levels shown and filter nodes (saveable as user presets). Zoom and seeing an application with its host are available in Service Mapping maps too. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/unified-map/cmdb-workspace-unified-map.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator, viewing the CMDB Data Foundations Dashboard, notices the Unique Locations Result percentage low.What is the recommended process from the associated playbook to correct this issue?

choices.text: Review both locations, update CIs with the correct location and delete the duplicate location
Retain the location that matches the organization’s standard naming convention, and delete the duplicate without further validation
Keep both locations as either can be used as a valid alternate location
Use the Duplicate CI Remediator the merge the duplicate location records

questions.explanation: The Unique Locations metric counts location records whose name is used more than once. The playbook approach is to review both records, repoint CIs to the correct location and then delete the duplicate. Locations aren't CIs, so the Duplicate CI Remediator doesn't apply. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-data-foundations-dashboard.html

questions.question: The CMDB Configuration Management team wants to manage de-duplication tasks generated from data ingested into the CMDB via the Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE).In which area of the CMDB Workspace can they locate these de-duplication tasks?

choices.text: Important actions tile under the Home tab
CMDB feature adoption tile under the Insight tab
Total status tile under the My Work tab

questions.explanation: De-duplication tasks generated by the IRE appear as cards in the Important actions tile on the CMDB Workspace Home view, which link to the De-duplication dashboard and template libraries. My Work holds CMDB Data Manager tasks. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-workspace-home-view.html

questions.question: A CMDB Owner starts on the CSDM journey and needs to become familiar with the CSDM domains. Drag the CMDB objects to the correct CSDM domains.
questions.explanation: Reconstructed (original drag-and-drop content was missing). Foundation holds referential data such as locations; Design & Planning holds business capabilities, applications and information objects; Build & Integration holds agile development (SDLC) components; Service Delivery holds service instances; Service Consumption holds business services and offerings. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/csdm-conceptual-model.html

targets.label: Foundation
Design & Planning
Build & Integration
Service Delivery
Service Consumption

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator is creating technical documentation for stakeholders, which includes a list of attributes, Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE) rules, and suggested relationships for several classes.Which central location does the CMDB Administrator use to collect this information?
questions.explanation: CI Class Manager is the central place to view each class's attributes, identification and reconciliation rules, dependent/suggested relationships and health settings. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/t_ViewTableDefinitions.html

questions.question: Which type of CMDB Data Manager policy creates tasks that allow the assigned individual to update fields on the CI record?
questions.explanation: Certification tasks let the reviewer edit field values to certify a CI when the policy has 'Allow field updates' selected. Attestation tasks only update attestation status. 'Compliance' and 'Audit' are not policy types. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/data-manager-create-policy-wrkspc.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator wants to educate the team on the various actions that can be performed within the CMDB Workspace.What actions can be initiated from the CMDB Workspace? (Choose two.)

choices.text: Create a CMDB Data Manager certification policy

questions.explanation: CMDB Workspace hosts the De-duplication dashboard/templates for remediating duplicate CIs and CMDB Data Manager / Data Certification, where certification policies are created. Discovery is run from Discovery tools (e.g. Discovery Admin Workspace) and classes are created in CI Class Manager, which the workspace only links to. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/data-cert-exp-cmdb-workspace.html

questions.question: A Configuration Manager is planning the implementation of the CMDB.Which is the prescribed CSDM rollout order?
questions.explanation: CSDM is implemented in stages: Foundation, Crawl, Walk, Run and, eventually, Fly. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/csdm-implementation-stages.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator wants to configure IRE rules for the CMDB. The CMDB Administrator opens CI Class Manager and sees the Identification Inclusion Rules option under a CI class's Identification Rule. How are these rules utilized by the IRE?

choices.text: To narrow the scope of CIs included in the identification process
To reduce the data ingested into the CMDB
To reconcile specific attributes based on data sources

questions.explanation: Identification inclusion rules (CI Class Manager > Identification Rule > Inclusion Rule) narrow the scope of existing CIs the IRE considers when matching (e.g. only Operational CIs). Health inclusion rules are a different feature: they only filter which CIs count in CMDB Health calculations. Note: some exam versions word this stem as 'Health Inclusion Rules', but the IRE behaviour described is identification inclusion. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/create-id-inclusion-rule.html

questions.question: A new ServiceNow customer is assembling a Configuration Management team to support their CMDB. Drag each role to its corresponding job description.
questions.explanation: Reconstructed from the CSDM persona descriptions (original drag-and-drop content was missing). Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/csdm-content-frame-exploring.html

items.text: Service Desk / Incident Manager / Change Manager

targets.label: Maintain the accuracy and integrity of the CMDB, certify data with SMEs and own the SACM processes
Identify and maintain Business Application records and align applications to capabilities and strategy
Own the service, create services and service offerings, and set the SLAs
Use CIs and service data to support operations, and review and approve changes

questions.question: A Windows administration team wants a grouping of CIs using CMDB groups.Which methods can be used? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: A CMDB group is populated by manually adding CIs, by saved CMDB Query Builder queries, or by encoded queries. Tag-based population belongs to tag-based application services, not CMDB groups. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-groups.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator seeks to understand the available tools for preventing, addressing, and remediating duplicate CIs. Drag and drop each feature with the corresponding outcome.
questions.explanation: Each de-duplication tool serves a specific purpose in managing duplicate CIs.

targets.label: Can be assigned to groups for resolving duplicate CIs
Offers insight into duplicate CIs within the CMDB
Offers a solution to resolve de-duplication tasks in bulk
Provides a wizard to resolve de-duplication tasks individually

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator is managing group data from both the CI Class Manager and a Technical Service Offering for a specific class.Cl Class Manager:- Managed by Group = Enterprise IT ServicesTechnical Service Offering:- Managed by Group = Windows Support- Change Group = Change Management TeamWhat would be the Managed By Group for CIs from this class based on the configured values?
questions.explanation: If Support, Change or Managed by group is set on the Technology Management Offering, the offering's value takes precedence; the CI Class Manager value only applies to CIs no offering manages. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/csdm-enable-tso.html

questions.question: A Configuration Manager needs to leverage a policy type to automate the creation and assignment of tasks to validate the existence of CIs.Which policy type should be used to accomplish this goal?
questions.explanation: Attestation policies create tasks in which owners confirm the real device or application still exists (Attested/Rejected). Certification validates attribute values, not existence. 'Promotion' and 'Verification' are not policy types. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-data-management.html

questions.question: A Service Portfolio Manager wants to know what Application Services their Business Service Offerings depend on.What stage of CSDM would map this relationship?
questions.explanation: Run adds Business Service Portfolio, Business Services and Business Service Offerings and relates them to the technology they consume (service instances) - enabling business-service impact assessment. Source: CSDM 5 white paper (ServiceNow); https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/csdm-datafdn-dash-run-tab.html

questions.question: Which is a purpose or requirement of CMDB Data Manager in ServiceNow?

choices.text: Encrypts archived records for enhanced security
Automates the enforcement of relationship rules between CIs in the CMDB
Automates the archival and deletion of records based on retention policies

questions.explanation: CMDB Data Manager is a policy-driven framework for bulk CI life-cycle operations such as retirement, archival, deletion and attestation. It does not encrypt records or enforce relationship rules. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-data-management.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator wants to leverage the CMDB Data Foundations Dashboard. What are benefits of using this application? (Choose two.)

choices.text: Checks that important data is valid and properly configured
Has a framework to create custom metrics for the CMDB
Provides playbooks to assist in the remediation of potential risks
Uses automation to remediate potential risks

questions.explanation: The CMDB Data Foundations dashboard checks that important data is valid and properly configured, and each metric links to a remediation playbook. It does not auto-remediate and has no custom-metric framework. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-data-foundations-dashboard.html

questions.question: A CMDB Data Manager needs to access the ServiceNow platform to create, publish, and manage policies that automate and govern CI lifecycle operations, ensuring the CMDB remains healthy and efficient.Where can the Data Manager do this?
questions.explanation: Policies are created, published and tracked from CMDB Workspace > Management > Data Manager (the 'Governance' view in newer releases). CI Class Manager and the CMDB 360 tab don't manage policies. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/yokohama/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/data-mgr-exp-cmdb-workspace.html

questions.question: A Configuration Manager needs to restrict the number of classes available in a Configuration Item reference field on an incident form.How does the Manager set Principal Classes?

choices.text: By using the Principal Class check box on the CI Class Manager's 'Basic Info' tab for a Class
By using the Principal Class check box on the CI Class Manager's 'Attributes' tab for a Class
By using the Principal Class attribute on the CI
By using the Principal Class check box on the CMDB Workspace

questions.explanation: Select the Principal Class check box in CI Class Manager > Class Info > Basic Info. CI reference fields on the task types in the principal-class filter property (incident, problem, change and their tasks) then show only CIs from principal classes. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/update-principal-class-filter.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator needs to prevent duplicate CI creation from import sets that load data into the CMDB from vendor shipment files containing CI information.How can the Administrator do this?

choices.text: Set the coalesce on two mappings within the transform map
Create comparison rules in the IRE
Set the system property to utilize the IRE within transform maps
Use the CMDBTransformUtil API in the transform script

questions.explanation: Coalescing only matches within the transform map and bypasses the IRE. ServiceNow's documented method is to call the CMDBTransformUtil API from an onBefore transform script so each row is identified by the IRE before insert. There is no system property that turns the IRE on for transform maps. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/identification-import-sets.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator wants to ensure all short-lived CIs that have not been discovered in the past week are removed.After retiring the CI records, which recommended action does the CMDB Administrator take?
questions.explanation: The documented Data Manager life cycle is: retirement definition -> Retire policy -> Delete (or Archive) policy targeting the retired CIs. The docs even use 'delete all containers that haven't been discovered in the past week' as the Delete policy example. Custom scripts, business rules or scheduled jobs are discouraged. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-data-management.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator has taken over management of a ServiceNow instance and has determined there are multiple deficiencies in the CMDB. During review of the CMDB Data Foundations Dashboard, the Administrator sees that ServiceNow offers Remediation Playbooks.How can Playbooks assist the Administrator in resolving these issues?

choices.text: Playbooks can be installed in the instance to automatically fix issues.
Playbooks can help analyze and fix issues.
Playbooks can automatically track common CMDB issues and output metrics.

questions.explanation: Remediation (Get Well) playbooks are Now Support knowledge articles linked from the Data Foundations dashboards. They give context and guidelines to analyze and fix an issue (Analyze, Fix and Govern plays). They are not installable automation. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-data-foundations-dashboard.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator utilizing the CMDB Data Foundations Dashboard sees an issue and wants to run a playbook.Which types of documentation can they expect to be provided in a playbook? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Each Data Foundations remediation playbook gives a summary of the indicator, an overview of the problem, why it is important to address it, and then how to fix or improve the score. Source: ServiceNow University KB0012913 (CIS-DF exam blueprint); ServiceNow University course 'CMDB Fundamentals' (Australia)

questions.question: A ServiceNow Administrator needs to create multiple new classes in the CMDB but wants to follow ServiceNow's best practices for naming CMDB tables to prevent technical debt.Which is the starting prefix for all custom CMDB tables?
questions.explanation: CI Class Manager automatically prefixes new class table names with 'u_cmdb_ci' (the prefix can't be changed). Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/t_CreateCIType.html

questions.question: The CMDB Administrator wants to leverage the Staleness metric from the CMDB Health Dashboard - Correctness Scorecard.Which field is used to calculate the duration of this metric?
questions.explanation: A CI is stale if it was not updated - based on the Updated [sys_updated_on] field - within the staleness rule's Effective Duration (60 days by default). Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/t_CreateCMDBHealthStaleRule.html

questions.question: A CSDM Data Manager needs metrics on the alignment of Technology Management Services (Technical Services) and Technology Management Offerings (Technical Service Offerings) with best practices.Which tab in the CSDM Data Foundation Dashboard provides this information?
questions.explanation: Walk adds Technology Management Services, Technology Management Offerings and Dynamic CI groups, so support and technical approval groups can be synchronized onto CIs from the offering. Run adds business services and offerings. Source: CSDM 5 white paper (ServiceNow); https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/csdm-datafdn-dash-walk-tab.html

questions.question: A data center has many servers. The CMDB Administrator wants to confirm that all servers exist.Which Data Manager policy type does the Administrator implement?
questions.explanation: Attestation policies create tasks in which owners confirm the real device or application still exists (Attested/Rejected). Certification validates attribute values, not existence. 'Promotion' and 'Verification' are not policy types. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-data-management.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator has installed a Service Graph Connector (SGC), and then made customizations to the mappings.Which is a consequence of this action?

choices.text: Fields populated by a customization will have a special tag associated with them in the CMDB.
The customization will prevent the SGC from executing without an approval record attached to the affected mapping record.
The customized mappings are not supported by ServiceNow, and the customer is responsible for supporting their own customized SGC.

questions.explanation: Once you customize an SGC's mappings you own them: upgrades skip your customized files and the customer must maintain/support them. There are no special field tags or approval records for customizations. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/service-graph-connectors/upgrade-sccm-newer-version.html

questions.question: Using existing baseline Data Manager policies, what condition must a CI meet before it can be archived or deleted?

choices.text: Be fully operational and in use
Be retired and in end of life

questions.explanation: Archive and Delete policies only process CIs that are already retired according to their class retirement definition - by CSDM default, Life Cycle Stage = End of Life and Life Cycle Stage Status = Retired. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/life-cycle-rules.html

questions.question: The Application Portfolio Management team is asking for help modeling platforms as Business Applications.How would this be mapped in CSDM using the ServiceNow Platform in the Incident and Change applications?

choices.text: ServiceNow Platform, Incident, and Change would all be web based Architecture type.Incident and Change would have a reference to ServiceNow Platform.
ServiceNow Platform would be an Architecture type of Platform Host.Incident and Change would be Platform Applications and have a reference to ServiceNow Platform.
ServiceNow Platform, Incident, and Change would all be web based Architecture type.A Depends On relationship would be created between ServiceNow Platform and Incident and Change.

ServiceNow Platform would be an Architecture type of Platform Host.Incident and Change would be Platform Applications.Then a Depends On relationship would be created between ServiceNow Platform and Incident and Change.

questions.explanation: The ServiceNow Platform is a Business Application with architecture type Platform Host; Incident and Change are Platform Applications whose Platform host reference points to it. No extra Depends On relationship is needed. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/application-portfolio-management/eaw-business-application-form.html

questions.question: A CMDB Data Owner has requested better insights on the different data sources that make up the CMDB data set. The Platform Owner knows that the new Service Graph Connector Central plugin is just what is needed. After installing the plugin, what workspace will have the new Service Graph Connector Central tab available?
questions.explanation: After SGC Central is installed, its view appears in CMDB Workspace (and Service Graph Workspace). There is no 'Service Graph Connector Workspace'. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/sgcc-landing.html

questions.question: The Configuration Management team wants to confirm that all servers in the CMDB actually exist in the data center.Which CMDB Data Manager policy type would the team create?
questions.explanation: Attestation policies create tasks in which owners confirm the real device or application still exists (Attested/Rejected). Certification validates attribute values, not existence. 'Promotion' and 'Verification' are not policy types. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-data-management.html

questions.question: An organization is updating the CMDB to include new asset types like IoT devices. Relevant CI classes need to be added and outdated ones need to be removed from the Principal Class filter to ensure accurate display in ITSM processes.Which roles are needed to add or remove classes? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: Updating the Principal Class filter requires sn_cmdb_admin (or itil_admin) plus personalize_dictionary, because it edits class (dictionary) metadata. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/update-principal-class-filter.html

questions.question: Drag and drop the CMDB Health Dashboard metric to the description.
questions.explanation: Each CMDB Health Dashboard metric has a specific meaning related to data quality.

targets.label: CMDB records that represent the same physical or logical asset multiple times
Fields necessary to create or update a CI record in the CMDB
CMDB records that no longer maintain their logical or physical relationships with other CIs
CMDB records that are no longer actively updated, but remain stored in the database
Fields that support the accuracy, completeness, and usability of CI records in the CMDB
Actual values of specified fields are compared to the expected values defined in a template

questions.question: The CMDB Health Dashboard is based on three Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): Correctness, Compliance, and Completeness. Each KPI includes several sub-metrics. Drag the sub-metrics to the KPI.
questions.explanation: Completeness: Required (and Recommended) fields; Compliance: Audit; Correctness: Orphan (and Duplicate, Stale). Stability, Certify and Suggested are not health sub-metrics. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/r_CMDBHealthMetrics.html

targets.label: Completeness

Correctness

questions.question: A CMDB Manager wants to start adding CSDM design and planning (design) domain components into the CMDB.Who is involved in this exercise? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: The CSDM 5 white paper names Enterprise Architect and Application Owner as the personas of the Design & Planning domain. Source: CSDM 5 white paper (ServiceNow); https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/design-domain.html

questions.question: What types of policies can be created within CMDB Data Manager? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: CMDB Data Manager policy types are Retire, Archive, Delete, Attestation, Certification and Delete CMDB Related Entry. De-duplication is handled by de-duplication tasks/templates and reconciliation by the IRE - neither is a Data Manager policy type. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-data-management.html

questions.question: The ITSM Manager wants to use Technology Management Offerings (Technical Service Offerings) to populate the support group of associated CIs.What CSDM stage would this be completed in?
questions.explanation: Walk adds Technology Management Services, Technology Management Offerings and Dynamic CI groups, so support and technical approval groups can be synchronized onto CIs from the offering. Run adds business services and offerings. Source: CSDM 5 white paper (ServiceNow); https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/csdm-implement-walk-stage.html

questions.question: Which default user groups are available when setting up a CMDB Data Manager policy and specifying the task assignment with the Assignment type set to 'User Group Field'? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: With Assignment type 'User Group Field', the list shows the target table's fields that reference the Groups table. On CMDB classes the standard ones are Managed By Group and Support Group (Managed By Group is Data Manager's default). 'Owned by' is a user field, not a group field. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/data-manager-create-policy-wrkspc.html

questions.question: During a CMDB implementation, a team member is tasked with ensuring the accuracy and completeness of CI data. This person is also responsible for maintaining data quality and resolving discrepancies.Which role is responsible for these tasks?
questions.explanation: The Configuration Manager owns the accuracy, completeness and quality of CMDB data and coordinates with CI owners to resolve discrepancies (CMDB Manager / CI analysts in the CSDM persona model). Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/common-service-data-model-csdm/csdm-content-frame-exploring.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator group aims to establish a process for receiving task notifications when the Support Group or Managed By Group fields are not populated for operational Linux servers stored in the CMDB.Which ServiceNow modules can be leveraged to configure recommended fields and generate task records in cases where these fields are missing for Linux servers in the CMDB?

choices.text: Technical Service Offerings and Dynamic CI groups
Dynamic CI groups and CMDB groups
CI Class Manager and Health Preferences

questions.explanation: Recommended fields are configured per class in CI Class Manager, and Health Preferences can create a task when a CI fails a metric (e.g. missing recommended fields). Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/t_ConfigureCMDBHealthMetrics.html

questions.question: A CMDB Administrator wants to leverage the Staleness metric from the CMDB Health Dashboard - Correctness Scorecard.What is the default duration of this metric?
questions.explanation: The base system includes a default staleness rule on the Configuration Item [cmdb_ci] class with an Effective Duration of 60 days; it applies to all child classes unless a class-specific rule overrides it. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/r_CMDBHealthMetrics.html

questions.question: A Configuration Manager responsible for a specific region wants to use the CMDB Health Dashboard to improve the data quality of the CMDB for that region. The Configuration Manager only sees the overall score and grouped by CI Class.How can the Configuration Manager get a score for regionally relevant CIs?

choices.text: On the CMDB health settings, activate the option, Group scores by region
Customize the CMDB Health Dashboard scheduled jobs to group the results by region
Create CMDB groups with type, health, by region

questions.explanation: Create CMDB groups of type Health (e.g. one per region). CMDB Health then monitors and scores just the CIs in that group, for example only CIs in a specific location. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-groups.html

questions.question: How does a CMDB Administrator use the ServiceNow Platform to ensure the data quality associated with CIs in the CMDB?
questions.explanation: CMDB Workspace is the central place to examine CMDB health and access the CMDB dashboards and governance tools. 'Data Quality Scheduled Job' and 'Data Quality Business Rule' aren't ServiceNow features. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/cmdb-workspace.html

questions.question: Which are CMDB Data Manager end of life policy types? (Choose two.)
questions.explanation: The life-cycle (end-of-life) policies are Retire, Archive and Delete; they require an active retirement definition for each targeted class. Lost, Decommission and Disposed are status values, not policy types. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/australia/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/data-manager-create-policy-wrkspc.html

questions.question: Where does a user with the appropriate role(s) review and manage the generated tasks after configuring CMDB Data Manager policies?

choices.text: CMDB Health Dashboard > Duplicate CIs tab

questions.explanation: Data Manager tasks (attestation, certification, life-cycle approvals) are reviewed in CMDB Workspace > My Work (renamed the 'Tasks' view in newer releases). The Management view is where policies are created and tracked. Source: https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/yokohama/servicenow-platform/configuration-management-database-cmdb/data-manager-review-task-wrkspc.html
